The fix file grew during this unit (21 -> 22 rows observed between two reads); another process may still be appending. The script prints n beside every statistic so a re-run states its own sample size, and figures here are those printed at run time.

max_tokens=4096 is applied identically to all four arms, so the cap cannot become an arm-level advantage; a cap change is a policy change, not a decision-rule change.
